label.title: International Security and Cooperation Strategies

claims.claim_text: Commitment to use diplomacy and development to confront global threats.
Support for working cooperatively with other governments and through the United Nations to solve global problems.
Commitment to provide assistance to other governments combating terrorism.
Commitment to strengthen national and multilateral capabilities to advance peace, security, and opportunity.
Commitment to pursue a tough, smart, and principled national security strategy.
Commitment to forge a more effective global response to terrorism.
Commitment to push for the ratification of the Comprehensive Nuclear-Test-Ban Treaty.
Commitment to continue responding to humanitarian crises around the globe together with the American people and the international community.
Commitment to reinforce alliances and partnerships that enhance collective security.
Commitment to work to maintain a strong, credible deterrent while reducing overreliance and excessive expenditure on nuclear weapons.
Support for multilateral international efforts that deny military and economic resources to authoritarian forces of all ideological stripes.
Support for demilitarization, decolonization, and striving for a future of international solidarity and cooperation toward global climate justice.

facts or infer positions for groups absent from the examples. If the claims mainly

policy subject, say so plainly in both title and caveat. Party names can appear
only when the party itself is the subject. Avoid vague titles like 'Policy and Society'.

The keywords are retrieval aids, not additional factual evidence.
